title: My best friend
instructions: Mia en yakın arkadaşı Zoe'yi anlatıyor. Görünüş ve "but" ile gelen farklara dikkat et.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: My best friend's name is Zoe.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: She is twelve years old, like me.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: Zoe is tall and she has long black hair.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: She has brown eyes and a big smile.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: She lives next to my house.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: Zoe is very good at sports. She plays tennis and football.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: I'm not good at sports, but I can sing.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: We go to the same school, but we aren't in the same class.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: At the weekend, we watch films together.

questions.feedback: Zoe uzun boylu (tall) ve uzun siyah saçlı. Kahverengi (brown) olan gözleri, saçı değil.
questions.evidence: Zoe is tall and she has long black hair.

questions.feedback: Zoe tenis ve futbol oynuyor. Şıklarda yalnızca tenis var.

questions.prompt: Are Mia and Zoe in the same class?
questions.feedback: Aynı okula gidiyorlar ama aynı sınıfta değiller (aren't in the same class).
questions.evidence: We go to the same school, but we aren't in the same class.
